Method of Attack: Remote code execution with superuser privileges via crafted UDP packet exploiting default admin password 888888
Firmware replacement with malicious version via microSD card without digital signature verification
Discoverer: Positive Technologies researchers Leonid Krolle and Georgy Zaytsev
Impacted Systems: potentially other Dongguan devices such as DVRs, surveillance cameras, and smart doorbells
Attack Vector: Remote authenticated attack exploiting default password 888888
